headline: Price of 12kg LPG cylinder rises by Tk 252, now Tk 1,837
summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the price of private sector LPG, with the price per kg rising by Tk 21.
details: The price of the most commonly used 12kg LPG cylinder has increased by Tk 252, rising from Tk 1,585 to Tk 1,837. The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) announced the new prices, which take effect from 6 PM today.
caption:
LPG prices are up. A 12kg cylinder now costs Tk 1,837 after a Tk 252 hike.

The price of the most commonly used 12kg LPG cylinder has increased by Tk 252, rising from Tk 1,585 to Tk 1,837. The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) announced the new prices, which take effect from 6 PM today.

#Bangladesh #LPGPrice #Economy #FuelPrice #BERC

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: Jamaat leader [[Akhtaruzzaman sent to jail]] after bail denied in airport assault case
headline: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman sent to jail after bail denied in airport assault case
summary: The former MP and retired Major was remanded and sent to prison following allegations of creating disorder and assaulting a security officer at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate denied bail to Jamaat-e-Islami leader and retired Major Akhtaruzzaman on Sunday, ordering him to be sent to jail.
caption:
Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman sent to jail after a court denied his bail in a case involving an airport assault.

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate denied bail to Jamaat-e-Islami leader and retired Major Akhtaruzzaman on Sunday, ordering him to be sent to jail.

#Bangladesh #Politics #CourtNews #Jamaat #Dhaka

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
